_read_me: Example rates for an example building business. Replace every number with your own before you send a real quote. SKILL.md walks your agent through it.
terms: Priced from our price list on the day of the quote. Any change to the work is priced and agreed in writing before it starts.
speech_hints: Site voice note for a building quote. Colorbond, Monument, Surfmist, Woodland Grey, Basalt, merbau, balustrade, vanity, waterproofing.

fence.label: Colorbond fence

length_m.label: Length (m)
length_m.means: Length of the fence in lineal metres, added up across every run.

height_m.label: Height (m)
height_m.means: Height of the fence in metres.

colour.label: Colour
colour.means: The Colorbond colour, for example Monument.

gates.label: Gates
gates.means: How many gates are asked for.

remove_old.label: Old work removed
remove_old.means: yes only when the speaker says the old fence comes out or goes to the tip.

checks: Send the neighbour a fencing notice before work starts.
Over 1.8 m high: check with council before you build.

deck.label: Hardwood deck

area_m2.label: Area (m²)
area_m2.means: Deck area in square metres. Length times width when both are said.

steps.label: Steps
steps.means: How many sets of steps are asked for.

balustrade_m.label: Balustrade (m)
balustrade_m.means: Length of balustrade or railing in metres.

remove_old.label: Old work removed
remove_old.means: yes only when the speaker says the old deck comes out.

checks: A floor more than 1 m above the ground needs a balustrade and may need council approval.

screen.label: Shower screen
screen.means: yes when a shower screen is asked for.

vanity.label: Vanity
vanity.means: yes when a new vanity is asked for.

toilet.label: Toilet
